items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: I used to play with his brother in the Tuxedo Brass Band, Eddie Jackson. I led the brass band, Papa Celestine and Eddie Jackson split up.

ctx.x: I used to play with his brother in the Tuxedo Brass Band, Eddie Jackson. I led the brass band, Papa Celestine and Eddie Jackson split up. I was lead man and Paggio was second, and Duran, Maurice Duran. We two was on solo.
Who else was in the band?
